Findings & Recommendations

FND-001 — Privileged access lacks enforced multi-factor authentication

Critical
Observation
Several administrative accounts on core infrastructure can authenticate with a password alone. This materially increases the likelihood of account takeover following credential compromise.
Recommendation
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for all privileged accounts and disable legacy password-only authentication paths within 30 days.
Owner
IAM Team · due 31 July 2026

FND-002 — Internet-facing VPN appliance missing critical patches

Critical
Observation
The remote-access VPN appliance is running firmware with known, actively exploited vulnerabilities. Exploitation could grant unauthenticated network access.
Recommendation
Apply vendor security updates immediately and add the appliance to the emergency patch SLA tier.
Owner
Infra Security · due 04 July 2026

FND-003 — Backup restoration is not routinely tested

High
Observation
While backups are taken, there is no documented evidence of periodic restoration testing, leaving recovery capability unverified against the stated RTO/RPO.
Recommendation
Establish a quarterly restoration test for tier-1 systems with documented results reviewed by IT Operations management.
Owner
IT Operations · due 30 September 2026

FND-004 — Sensitive data stored without encryption at rest

High
Observation
Personally identifiable information is persisted in an analytics store without encryption at rest, increasing impact in the event of unauthorized data store access.
Recommendation
Enable storage-level encryption and rotate keys via the managed KMS; classify and minimize PII retained in analytics.
Owner
Data Engineering · due 31 August 2026

FND-005 — Secrets committed to a public code repository

Medium
Observation
Historical commits in a public repository contain credentials. Although rotated, the exposure highlights gaps in pre-commit secret scanning.
Recommendation
Adopt automated secret scanning in CI and pre-commit hooks, and complete a repository history purge for the affected project.
Owner
DevSecOps · due 15 August 2026
